description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that displays a log view within a scrollable interface. It manages a LogView component, sets up its layout, appearance, and behavior, and handles text change events to keep the view scrolled to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that contains a LogView inside a ScrollView, used for displaying log data and automatically scrolling to the latest entries.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, appearance, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
